findings.title: Goal authorization fails open when the confirmed projection has no proposal
findings.details: GoalExecution.evaluate/5 returns :unmanaged when game-api successfully returns a projection whose proposal is nil, and AgentRunner then starts the Codex turn without authorization inheritance or a shared-budget check. For a BOS Goal-scoped delivery issue, missing or malformed authorization state must pause or error rather than silently downgrade the issue to unmanaged.
findings.evidence: elixir/lib/symphony_elixir/goal_execution.ex check/evaluate; elixir/lib/symphony_elixir/agent_runner.ex do_run_codex_turns; goal_execution_test.exs asserts a fetched nil proposal is :unmanaged.

findings.title: Malformed execution windows and budget values are accepted by the local enforcement guard
findings.details: parse_datetime/1 converts malformed timestamps to nil and outside_window?/2 treats nil bounds as unrestricted. number/1 converts malformed ceilings and consumption to nil, and exceeds?/3 ignores nil limits or substitutes zero consumption. This permits local authorization to proceed instead of failing closed on corrupted or schema-incompatible security inputs.
findings.evidence: elixir/lib/symphony_elixir/goal_execution.ex outside_window?/2, parse_datetime/1, exceeds?/3, number/1; goal_execution_test.exs explicitly expects a malformed startsAt value to authorize.

summary: Exact-commit checks pass and local/remote SHAs match, but the Goal authorization guard has fail-open paths for missing proposals and malformed window/budget data. These security-boundary inputs must fail closed before this high-risk change can pass.
